summary: The ordinary /api/teaching/operations/audit GET route now rejects signed teacher cookies whose actorId or sessionId is not a safe server identity before course ownership checks or audit readback runs.

redGreenEvidence.command: npx vitest run tests/teaching-operation-backend.test.ts --reporter=dot -t "unsafe signed audit readback actor ids"
redGreenEvidence.observed: Failed with HTTP 200 because a validly signed but unsafe audit readback actorId reached ownership and audit readback instead of being rejected at the authenticated-session boundary.

redGreenEvidence.command: npx vitest run tests/teaching-operation-backend.test.ts --reporter=dot -t "unsafe signed audit readback session ids"
redGreenEvidence.observed: Failed with HTTP 200 because a validly signed but unsafe audit readback sessionId reached ownership and audit readback instead of being rejected at the authenticated-session boundary.

redGreenEvidence.command: npx vitest run tests/teaching-operation-backend.test.ts --reporter=dot -t "unsafe signed audit readback actor ids|unsafe signed audit readback session ids|lets the owning teacher read a redacted teaching operation audit"

behaviorHardened: Signed audit readback cookies whose actorId fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Signed audit readback cookies whose sessionId fails the safe-id boundary now resolve as unauthenticated and return HTTP 401 with authenticated-session-required.
Unsafe signed identity claims are rejected before course ownership checks, external audit adapters, or local audit database readback run.
The denial response preserves trace id and redaction without echoing unsafe local-path or secret-like identity values.
